replies.author: Arachadonic
replies.body:
Gameplay might be a bit boring.. It's simply a case of spawn, run forward a bit, fightfightfight, die and repeat. It's always good if you add multiple routes which is what you will find in many good maps. I also feel like spawn killing will be rampant.

its not bad though. When I saw the title the first thing I thought of was Lavender town :p
